# Ingredient Preferences

Brand and label preferences per ingredient. Feeds grocery list detail and the
Publix pickup flow (search queries and product picks get built from these).

## House dietary principles (Cooper, 2026-07-26)

- Avoid foods containing vegetable/seed oils wherever practical - check labels;
  prefer olive oil, avocado oil, butter, tallow.
- Prefer organic when and where possible, even at a premium.
- Prefer grass-fed / organic beef over conventional.
- Cost still matters: organic-when-reasonable, not organic-at-any-price.
- Planner behavior: weekly planning conversations START by asking what is on
  hand (fridge/freezer/pantry) so it gets used first.

## Per-ingredient preferences

- ground beef: Thousand Hills Lifetime Grazed 100% Grass Fed, 70/30
- chicken: Farmer Focus organic free-range (boneless skinless thighs)
- frozen vegetables: GreenWise Organic (Publix house organic brand)
- yogurt: Stonyfield Organic plain whole milk; FAGE 5% plain Greek
- honey: raw and unfiltered organic

## Publix purchase-history insights (from Jul 6 + Jul 12, 2026 orders)

- Store: Publix pickup, 1030 Forestville Rd, Wake Forest NC (Ashlyn's account).
- Produce is ALWAYS organic when available: strawberries, blueberries.
- Meat is premium organic/grass-fed by brand: Thousand Hills (beef),
